title: 第15章 失魂落魄第16章 头铁第一名
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
第15章失魂落魄
这个手札的书写者，名字叫王阳明。
李婉：咦？怎么跟明朝那个思想家同名啊！
出生在顶级修真世家王家，家里兄弟姐妹都生来便有灵根，可以修炼。
只有他一个人，生无灵根，根本感知不到身边的灵气。
少时，曾有同伴同他坦言五灵根修炼慢，经脉弱，存灵少的痛苦，听后，王阳明不觉得这是在诉苦，更像是在炫耀。
在一个没有灵根的人面前，侃侃而谈，修炼中遇见的各种问题，纯纯就是凡尔赛。
自那以后，王阳明心里就种下了一个种子。
他要修炼，他一定要修炼。
事在人为，既然天生没有灵根，那就给自己生一个灵根。
他尝试了很多种方法，因为出生高贵，也有能力做尝试。
但是他的所有尝试都失败了。
就在他绝望之时。
同家中弟弟一道去了秘境历练，别问他一个凡人怎么能去秘境历练的，问就是使用了特权。
只要有权有势，他哪里都去得。
而王家父母因为他生无灵根，只能活短短百年，只要能做到的，便事事依他。
不过是去秘境而已，只要拿掉家族中某个小喽啰的名额，就能让爱子开心。
何乐而不为。
王阳明这次去的秘境乃百年才出现一次的浮空境，一开始一切都正常，王阳明带着护卫满秘境的跑，祈祷能找到一个生出灵根的契机。
但是这次一如从前，毫无所获。

就在秘境快要关闭的时候。
秘境之中突然乱了起来，所有人都朝着秘境中心飞去。
原因是秘境中有神器出世。
修真界中法器分为花、玄、地、天、灵、仙、神几个等级，如今修真界中最高等级的器乃仙器，神器早在千年以前就消失在这片大地。
而现在听说有神器出世，在秘境中的哪一个不想分得一杯羹？
一场乱战就此开始。
秘境中的人打得昏天黑地，血流成河，只为抢夺那把出世的神器。
可是众人不知，这把神器有裂，在承受许多的攻击后，本就有裂缝的神器，裂缝变得更加巨大，最终在天雷的攻击下，碎成了无数的碎片。
秘境中人皆受神器所伤，就连早已经等在秘境出口准备出去的王阳明也不例外。
他不幸地被神器刺中了丹田。
凡人之躯，怎堪受神器攻击，王阳明当下便不省人事了。
但奇迹的事，他并没有因此死亡，而是因祸得福，神器在他体内化成了罕见的雷灵根。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Lost and Lost
The name of the writer of this note is Wang Yangming.
Li Wan: Huh? Why do you have the same name as that thinker from the Ming Dynasty?
Born in the Wang family, a top cultivation family, all the brothers and sisters in the family are born with spiritual roots and can cultivate.
He was the only one who had no spiritual roots and could not sense the spiritual energy around him at all.
When he was young, a companion once confessed to him the pain of slow cultivation of the Five Spiritual Roots, weak meridians, and lack of spiritual existence. After hearing this, Wang Yangming felt that this was not a complaint, but more like a show off.
In front of a person who has no spiritual roots, talking about the various problems encountered in cultivation is purely Versailles.
Since then, a seed has been planted in Wang Yangming's heart.
If he wants to practice, he must practice.
It all depends on human effort. Since you are born without spiritual roots, then give yourself a spiritual root.
He tried many methods because he was born noble and had the ability to try.
But all his attempts failed.
Just when he was desperate.
I went to the secret realm to practice with my younger brother. Don't ask him how a mortal could go to the secret realm to practice. Ask him just because he used his privileges.
As long as he has power, he can go anywhere.
As for the Wang family's parents, because he was born without spiritual roots and could only live for a short period of a hundred years, they relied on him in everything they could as long as they could.
It's just a trip to a secret realm. As long as you take away the quota of a certain gangster in the family, you can make Aiko happy.
Why not.
The secret realm that Wang Yangming went to this time was a floating realm that only appeared once in a century. Everything was normal at first. Wang Yangming ran around the secret realm with his guards, praying to find an opportunity to give birth to spiritual roots.
But this time, as before, nothing was gained.
Just when the secret realm was about to close.
There was sudden chaos in the secret realm, and everyone flew towards the center of the secret realm.
The reason is that an artifact was born in the secret realm.
In the world of cultivation, magical artifacts are divided into several levels: flower, mysterious, earth, heaven, spirit, immortal, and god. Nowadays, the highest level artifacts in the world of cultivation are immortal artifacts. Divine artifacts disappeared from this land thousands of years ago.
And now that I heard that an artifact was born, who in the secret realm doesn’t want to get a share of it?
A chaotic battle began.
The people in the secret realm fought till death, with blood flowing like rivers, just to snatch the artifact that was born.
But what everyone didn't know was that this artifact had cracks. After withstanding many attacks, the cracks in the artifact became even larger, and eventually broke into countless pieces under the attack of the sky thunder.
Everyone in the secret realm was injured by the artifact, even Wang Yangming, who had been waiting at the exit of the secret realm to get out, was no exception.
Unfortunately, he was stabbed in the Dantian by the artifact.
How could a mortal body be attacked by a divine weapon? Wang Yangming fell unconscious immediately.
But miraculously, he did not die because of this, but it was a blessing in disguise. The artifact turned into the rare thunder spirit root in his body.
